data.body: Final live verification: repair was a Gerrit container restart only; no Gerrit git-data mutation was performed, so no snapshot was required for this step. Triggered full replication with `replication start --all --remote github --now --wait`. GitHub main caught up to Gerrit main at cc3b80b4a084716c52194f40d98208f487c07e91 immediately after repair, then later advanced normally to da60b2335e1dee65d645d4701b5ca8954060ee17 after subsequent submits. Mirror Guard manual run 34236004089 passed on head cc3b80b4a084716c52194f40d98208f487c07e91. CloudWatch rebar-gerrit-mirror-out-of-sync returned OK at 2026-09-08T14:06:59Z. Replication config pushes refs/heads/main, refs/tags/*, refs/changes/*, and refs/heads/feature/*; it does not push refs/heads/tickets or refs/meta/*.
